modmenu.summaryTranslation.salts_invento: Desktop-style inventory upgrades with expandable storage, movable windows, pins, resizing, and API hooks.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.salts_inv:
Salt's Inventory Update upgrades Minecraft's inventory workflow with expandable player storage, desktop-style movable container windows, pin and ghost-pin controls, resize and snapping options, and API hooks for supported inventory screens. Configure it with /saltsinventory config or the mod-list config button.

Discord: https://discord.gg/kfdE9gGGxP
API: https://salt-and-fries.github.io/Salt-s-Inventory-Update/
Source: https://github.com/Salt-and-Fries/Salt-s-Inventory-Update
Donate: https://www.paypal.com/donate/?business=ERE5F32WV4NWN&no_recurring=1&currency_code=USD
config.salts_inventory_update.title: Salt's Inventory Update Settings
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_mod: Turns Salt's Inventory Update gameplay features on or off. When off, vanilla inventory and container screens are used and Salt desktop networking stays inactive.
config.salts_inventory_update.expandable: Shows the add-slot button in the player inventory and creative inventory tab. Turning this off hides the button without deleting existing expanded inventory contents.
config.salts_inventory_update.return_hot: Places the hotbar below the player inventory and creative windows and the offhand slot in the character window. The normal HUD hotbar is hidden while any Salt window is open.
config.salts_inventory_update.window_ope: Controls where newly opened container windows appear before you move or pin them.
config.salts_inventory_update.open_unloc: Makes newly created unsaved windows start movable. Saved per-window lock states still take priority.
config.salts_inventory_update.allow_resi: Allows supported storage windows and API windows to be resized when they are unlocked.
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_win: When a resized window is released, trims extra empty space so the content grid fits cleanly. Disable this to keep exact resized dimensions.
config.salts_inventory_update.reset_lock: When a window is locked again, returns it to its default position and size while preserving its pin mode.
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_gho: Allows the pin button to cycle into Ghost Pinned mode. When disabled, the pin button skips ghost pins and existing ghost-pinned windows act like normal pinned windows.
config.salts_inventory_update.global_pin: Shares pinned layouts for player and other non-block windows across all worlds and servers. Windows attached to blocks, such as chests, remain saved per world and block.
config.salts_inventory_update.persistent: Clears windows from the screen instead of closing them when E is held or Esc is pressed, then restores them the next time a Salt window opens.
config.salts_inventory_update.minimizabl: Shows the minimize button on Salt windows. When off, windows stay expanded and the minimize control is hidden.
config.salts_inventory_update.open_inven: Open Inventory When Containers Are Opened
Automatically opens the player inventory window when a visible container window opens.
config.salts_inventory_update.ghost_wind: Controls how visible ghost-pinned window previews are when rendered over the world.
config.salts_inventory_update.e_hold_clo: How long E must be held to close all Salt windows. The close-all popup appears after one quarter of this time.
config.salts_inventory_update.enable_det: Adds verbose Salt desktop logs for container capture, window rendering, slot rendering, API/custom windows, and packet flow while debugging mod pack issues.
config.salts_inventory_update.force_cont: Opens a registry-driven list of every known menu container. Checked entries are forced through Salt's desktop window path, including vanilla menus changed by other mods and modded menu types.
config.salts_inventory_update.runtime_di: Disabled for this server because Salt desktop networking is unavailable.
config.salts_inventory_update.recipe_bro: Set as default recipe browser tab

instructions.salts_inventory_update.desk: Inventory, crafting, and containers can stay open together as movable windows.
Open several chests to move items between them without closing the desktop.
Use Next to tour the controls and settings. Scroll longer pages for more details.
Run /saltsinventory help to reopen this guide;
instructions.salts_inventory_update.cont: Toggle the inventory window; while riding a storage entity, toggle its container with it.
Toggle the Character window for armor, offhand, and crafting.
Toggle the recipe browser window, if a browser is installed.
Close all windows after the configured hold time.
Switch between cursor and camera or hotbar control.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.item: Left-click picks up or places a stack; right-click handles half a stack or places one item.
Drag left to divide a held stack; drag right to place one per slot. Double-click collects matching items across windows.
Shift-click quick-moves items toward the focused window when it can receive them.
Interact with a block to open its container beside your other windows.
Only visible, active windows accept normal item interactions.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.arra: Unlock a window, then drag its title bar to move it.
With Allow Resizing on, drag the bottom-right corner of a supported unlocked window.
Window Snapping trims extra empty space when resizing ends.
Pin a window to remember its position. Lock it to prevent movement or resizing.
Container windows can remain open together for sorting and crafting.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.butt: Focus: Shift-clicked items move directly into the focused window when possible.
Pin: Saves this window's position for the next time it opens. Click to pin or unpin.
Lock: Prevents the window from being moved or resized. Click to lock or unlock.
More Controls: find buttons that do not fit on the title bar.
Link: Select another highlighted window to make linked windows open and close together.
Minimize: Collapses the window into a title bar to keep your screen less cluttered.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.more: While riding a chest boat or another inventory entity, its window and your inventory open and close together.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.butt: Click on inventory or a container to sort its items into other open storage windows.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.sort: Moves items only into storage already holding the same item type.
Unmatched items and anything that does not fit stay in the source.
Tries exact items, then shared item tags, then focused storage, then empty storage windows.
Full destinations are skipped; remaining items stay in the source.
Inventory sorting uses main inventory slots, not hotbar, armor, offhand, or crafting.
A storage window sorts its own storage slots. Furnaces sort output only; brewing stands sort bottles, including during brewing.
Only other visible storage windows receive items. Minimized and ghost windows are ignored.
The inventory and processing windows never receive sorted items.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.inve: The Character window holds armor, offhand, and personal crafting slots.
Enable Return Hotbar to Inventory to place the hotbar below Inventory and Creative, and offhand in Character.
Enable Expandable Inventory to show an add-slot button in Inventory or Creative.
Spend the displayed XP level cost to buy a slot; turning the option off only hides the button.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.sett: Settings: essentials
Open settings
Use /saltsinventory config or the mod-list Config button. Scroll the settings page for more options.
Gameplay
Enable the Mod: switch between Salt windows and vanilla inventory screens.
Expandable Inventory: show the XP-priced add-slot control.
Return Hotbar to Inventory: move hotbar below inventory and offhand into Character.
Reset Defaults restores the settings shown on the config screen.
Settings: layout
New windows
Window Opening Style: choose Top Outside, Around the Inventory, or Vintage Story placement.
Open Unlocked: new windows start movable unless a saved lock state exists.
New windows
Allow Resizing: resize supported unlocked windows.
Enable Window Snapping: trim unused space after a resize.
Reset Locked Windows: restore default position and size when locking.
Settings: pins
Pin options
Enable Ghost Pins: add a translucent preview mode to the Pin button.
Ghost Window Opacity: adjust how strongly those previews appear over the world.
Global Pins: share player and other non-block layouts across worlds, block containers keep local layouts.
Ghost previews
A ghost preview is not an active container. Interact with its source to use it again.
Settings: behavior
Opening and closing
Persistent Windows: hide on Esc or Hold E, then restore on the next opening; hold Esc to close all.
Minimizable Windows: show the Minimize title-bar control.
Open Inventory When Containers Are Opened: show inventory alongside visible containers.
E Hold Close-All Time: set the hold duration; the prompt appears after one quarter of it.
Settings: compatibility
Modded menus
Force Containers as Windows: choose registered menu types that should use Salt windows.
Use Clear Forced in that list to remove your overrides.
Supported modded storage, such as Sophisticated Storage, can open beside vanilla containers.
Troubleshooting
Enable Detailed Console Logs adds verbose desktop and network diagnostics.
Some features require Salt desktop support on the server.
When JEI, REI, or EMI is installed
Look up recipes or uses for the item under the cursor.
Search ingredients, recipes, uses, favorites, and recent items.
Move Items fills compatible Salt crafting windows when ingredients are available.
instructions.salts_inventory_update.toms: Storage and crafting terminals appear as Salt windows.
Terminal search, sorting, and recipes stay inside the window.
Filters, inventory links, level emitters, and filing cabinets use Salt layouts.
